Privacy notice

The organizing team will use the information you provide to respond to your inquiry and coordinate your involvement in wheelchair softball events. Please do not include sensitive personal or medical information.

Before the event

Equipment and participation

The organizer is confirming equipment, cost, age and eligibility details. Ask about your situation through the interest form before making arrangements to attend.

Venue access and event time

The organizer has planned the first event for May 8, 2027 at Roy Holiday Field in Scarborough. Use the form to ask about the start time or venue access. The map link searches the venue name supplied by the organizer.

Posters, graphics and videos

Professor Parks has photos and videos from playing wheelchair softball. If you can create posters, promotional graphics, or a highlight reel, choose graphic design or video help in the form and share a portfolio link if you have one.
